components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The strongest next action, rendered as ink with yellow type and a tactile yellow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 4px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 16px; background: #1A1A1A; color: var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); font: 900 10px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-action-capture, #00C853); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Capture Button
components.description: A positive action that protects, confirms, or captures money.
components.css: .ds-btn-capture { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 4px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-action-capture, #00C853); color: var(--capture-contrast, #000); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 0 #1A1A1A; font: 900 10px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-capture:hover, .ds-btn-capture:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-capture:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Amount Input
components.description: A heavy outlined monetary field with a ledger-like numeric voice.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-primary, #111); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--text-secondary, #656565); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-field-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 4px solid var(--border-primary, #1A1A1A); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bg-input, #E5E3DE); font: 700 18px/1.2 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-field-box input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-field-box:focus-within { background: var(--bg-secondary, #FAFAF9); outline: 3px solid var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Compact categorical choice with a clear raised selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { padding: 6px 12px; border: 2px solid var(--border-primary, #1A1A1A); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bg-input, #E5E3DE); color: var(--text-secondary, #656565); font: 900 10px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #111); border-color: #000; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-action-capture, #00C853); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #1A1A1A; color: var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); border-color: #1A1A1A; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: A surfaced financial grouping with thick structure and hard feature depth.
components.html:
CLEARED TODAY$1,248

After committed bills and savings.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; padding: 24px; border: 4px solid var(--border-primary, #1A1A1A); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--bg-secondary, #FAFAF9); color: var(--text-primary, #111); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 0 var(--shadow-color, rgba(0,0,0,.88)); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { display: block; color: var(--text-secondary, #656565); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-card-value { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font: 700 32px/1 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-card p { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary, #656565); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: A phone-width bottom pill with equal touch targets and a yellow active destination.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; width: min(100%, 420px); padding: 6px; border: 3px solid var(--border-primary, #1A1A1A); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--bg-secondary, #FAFAF9); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--shadow-color, rgba(0,0,0,.88)); } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 56px; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 4px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #656565); font: 900 9px/1.1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #111); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-action-capture, #00C853); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--color-action-primary, #facc15); color: var(--primary-contrast, #000); border-color: #1A1A1A; }

components.name: Risk Callout
components.description: A factual financial warning using a red tint and compact high-contrast copy.
components.css: .ds-risk { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--color-action-bleed, #E8174B); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-action-bleed, #E8174B) 10%, transparent); color: var(--color-action-bleed, #E8174B); font: 900 10px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-risk span { font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
PocketCFO feels like a compact physical ledger rebuilt for quick decisions on a phone. Heavy outlines, offset shadows, dense labels, and paper-toned surfaces give financial information weight without making it formal or distant. The system is candid and tactile: controls look pressable, states look deliberate, and the most important number reads immediately.

Signal colors carry meaning rather than decoration. Yellow marks the primary path, green marks money captured or a safe completion, red marks loss or risk, and gold marks goals. The visual system can shift between light and dark and accepts user-selected accent pairs, but the hierarchy, contrast, and semantic distinction between actions remain stable.
keyCharacteristics: Thick, high-contrast outlines and hard offset shadows.
Warm paper neutrals in light mode and charcoal layers in dark mode.
Black, italic, tightly tracked display type paired with small uppercase labels.
Monospaced, tabular figures for money and calculated values.
Compact mobile layouts with generous touch targets and bottom-sheet interactions.
Bright signal colors reserved for actions, outcomes, targets, and risk.

rules.name: The Signal Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Yellow means primary or selected, green means captured or successfully completed, red means risk or destructive action, and gold means a target. Do not use these colors as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Keeps the Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Custom accent pairs may change brand expression, but they must preserve foreground contrast and the distinction between primary action, capture, and risk.

rules.name: The Ledger Number Rule
rules.body: Money and comparable calculations use the monospaced numeric voice; prose and actions use the sans-serif voice.

rules.name: The Label Earns Its Volume Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels stay short. Explanations use sentence case rather than forcing whole paragraphs into display styling.

rules.name: The Shadow Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Use zero-blur offset shadows to establish importance or interaction. Do not add ambient blur, glass, or decorative glow as a default material.

rules.name: The Press Completes the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Interactive raised controls move into their shadow and lose it on hover, press, or active feedback.

dos: **Do** make the safe-to-spend amount the clearest number on the dashboard.
**Do** use the same semantic color for the same financial meaning across screens.
**Do** preserve the paper, ink, thick-border, and hard-shadow construction in both light and dark themes.
**Do** use monospaced tabular numerals for money and comparable calculations.
**Do** keep touch targets generous and layout rows resilient to long labels and localized values.
**Do** treat user-selected themes as controlled substitutions for primary and capture accents while retaining contrast.
**Do** honor reduced-motion preferences and visible keyboard focus.
donts: **Don't** introduce soft glass panels, diffuse SaaS shadows, gradient text, or low-contrast gray-on-color copy.
**Don't** use yellow, green, red, or gold decoratively when it would weaken their financial meaning.
**Don't** multiply card containers without a grouping reason or nest equally heavy cards inside one another.
**Don't** present two daily-availability numbers that apply different calculations or unexplained modifiers.
**Don't** change icon weight, border thickness, or corner scale arbitrarily between selected and unselected states.
**Don't** use moralizing success or failure language for spending behavior.
